entries.dialogueText: Standing on a remote mountain plateau outside of Naeal, the Silver Garrison was the headquarters of the Derdian government as well as the dwelling place of its leader, Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For our meeting today, Azmal had gr..."
entries.dialogueText: For our meeting today, Azmal had granted me the rare permission to enter his inner sanctum.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""These are Seekers, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are Seekers, Your Majesty. It is said that through their physical labor, they will gain the mental clarity they need to begin their pursuit of Golconda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They do all the dirty work while t..."

entries.dialogueText: "Not at all, Your Majesty. Women in Derdian Golcondist communities are often limited to the Seeker role, while men are permitted to advance."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It will be a long one. Few women a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be a long one. Few women are ever allowed to progress past the Seeker role."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""A Seeker's work is only holy when..."
entries.dialogueText: "A Seeker's work is only holy when performed on behalf of the entire community, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I think His Majesty was joking, si..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think His Majesty was joking, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the guards led us closer to the..."
entries.dialogueText: As the guards led us closer to the pillar, the sound of men's voices could be heard. Short, sharp shouts, emitted in perfect unison.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Welcome to the Silver Garrison, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome to the Silver Garrison, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the demonstration, S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the demonstration, Supreme Wiseman. The skill of your Disciples is admirable indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A gong chimed in the distance. Almo..."
entries.dialogueText: A gong chimed in the distance. Almost instantly, the Disciples spread out to form a perfect circle around us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am humbled to be here, Mr. Azmal.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am humbled to be here, Mr. Azmal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "No time for dance moves. I need to talk to you now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The honor is mine. Never before ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "The honor is mine. Never before has any king of Rizia been such a friend to the Golcondists."

entries.dialogueText: "You're speaking to Romus the Generous here. Bring it on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know better than to engage Golco..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know better than to engage Golcondists in a duel, Mr. Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would be a great privilege to p..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be a great privilege to participate in your holy tradition."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I have read of this ceremony, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have read of this ceremony, Your Majesty. It is a polite show of skill, not an all-out fight."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Talum esthari zirak na'leen!""
entries.dialogueText: "Talum esthari zirak na'leen!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spread his arms wide."
entries.dialogueText: He spread his arms wide.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The circle of men flattened out int..."
entries.dialogueText: The circle of men flattened out into a long line. Azmal slowly walked from one end to the other, then back to the middle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood in front of a particularly..."
entries.dialogueText: He stood in front of a particularly tall, well-built Disciple and bowed. The man took a step forward and returned the gesture.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Correct, Grand Wiseman. No weapons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct, Grand Wiseman. No weapons, no bloodshed. Each leader represented by a champion of his choosing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spread his arms wide."
entries.dialogueText: He spread his arms wide.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Captain Gordion. I have heard tale..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion. I have heard tales of your fighting prowess, both before and after you began serving the King."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have. Captain Gordion shall repr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have. Captain Gordion shall represent me in the Duel of Generosity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I will serve as my own champio..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I will serve as my own champion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually... I'm not comfortable wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually... I'm not comfortable with this. May we pray instead?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty. I unders..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. I understand that the way we do things in Derdia is rather... unorthodox to non-Golcondists."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I will be represented by Loran. Hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be represented by Loran. His participation in this duel shall be his final challenge before his ascension to the rank of Adept."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rest of the Disciples applauded..."
entries.dialogueText: The rest of the Disciples applauded. Sal politely followed suit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal turned towards Titus. My body..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal turned towards Titus. My bodyguard tensed up instinctively.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Am I right to assume that you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Am I right to assume that you have brought this man as your champion, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone went silent for a second."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone went silent for a second.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty... This man looks lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... This man looks like trouble. Even for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal nudged Titus forward. The capta..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal nudged Titus forward. The captain bowed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes. I will do my best to make the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I will do my best to make the Crown proud, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal shook his head in disappointm..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal shook his head in disappointment. The fighter he'd chosen reluctantly stepped back into line.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Loran nodded his assent and walked away. He knelt on a patch of grass and raised his arms skyward in prayer, his face a mask of concentration.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""All right. But let me know if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. But let me know if you need help."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I don't mean to doubt your capabil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't mean to doubt your capabilities. I will be standing at the ready in case you need backup."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Be careful. With his build, even a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful. With his build, even an accidentally landed hit could prove deadly."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If you insist, sir. I will be stan..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist, sir. I will be standing at the ready in case you need help."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus removed his blazer. He perfor..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus removed his blazer. He performed a few stretches and started throwing practice jabs in the air.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This is highly unorthodox, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is highly unorthodox, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked over to him."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't pull any punches, Captain Go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't pull any punches, Captain Gordion. Show Derdia what a real fighter looks like."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you can take him, Titus. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you can take him, Titus. But I want you to let him win."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why aren't you praying? The other..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why aren't you praying? The other guy is praying."

entries.title: Narrator: "A short while later, another gong s..."
entries.dialogueText: A short while later, another gong sounded. The Disciples formed a tight circle around Titus and the man Jorga Azmal had called Loran.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Supreme Wiseman stepped between..."
entries.dialogueText: The Supreme Wiseman stepped between them.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The duel will last 10 minutes, or..."
entries.dialogueText: "The duel will last 10 minutes, or until one opponent acknowledges the other's superior skill in combat. Should a fighter draw blood, the duel will be called off immediately, its results void before the Lord."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You will bow to one another, and t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will bow to one another, and the duel will commence."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stepped back into the circle. He..."
entries.dialogueText: He stepped back into the circle. He and the Disciples began a slow, deep-voiced chant in Derdian as Titus and Loran bowed to one another.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moment they began sparring, it..."
entries.dialogueText: The moment they began sparring, it was obvious how evenly matched they were.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Derdian fighter moved with a fl..."
entries.dialogueText: The Derdian fighter moved with a fluid unpredictability; Titus with sharp, deliberate precision. Every strike was met with a parry; every advance with a retreat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I snuck a look at Jorga Azmal. The..."
entries.dialogueText: I snuck a look at Jorga Azmal. The Supreme Wiseman seemed utterly spellbound by the spectacle unfolding before us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, I heard a cry of pain. Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, I heard a cry of pain. Titus was doubled over on the ground, clutching his side just below his ribcage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""KICK HIS ASS, TITUS!""
entries.dialogueText: "KICK HIS ASS, TITUS!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop this duel at once!""
entries.dialogueText: "Stop this duel at once!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be an idiot! Concede!""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be an idiot! Concede!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loran, looking dumbfounded, reached..."
entries.dialogueText: Loran, looking dumbfounded, reached a hand down to help. Titus swatted it away and lurched unsteadily to his feet. He had a look in his eyes that bordered on feral.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Something seemed to snap in my body..."
entries.dialogueText: Something seemed to snap in my bodyguard. He became a whirlwind of fists and feet, landing blow after blow on his Derdian opponent.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Your Majesty... Captain Gordion......"
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... Captain Gordion... please..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loran weakly held his hands in fron..."
entries.dialogueText: Loran weakly held his hands in front of his face, attempting to concede. Titus ignored him and delivered a final, brutal punch to the jaw.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked at me and nodded weakl..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked at me and nodded weakly. He put up both of his hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and Loran stepped away from e..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and Loran stepped away from each other, looking confused. Azmal signaled to the circle to stop chanting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and Loran stared each other d..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and Loran stared each other down for a moment, then resumed their dance, this time with a slightly more aggressive edge.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I don't understand. It was just a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand. It was just a light jab..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal signaled for the chanting to..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal signaled for the chanting to stop. He and his champion looked at each other, their triumph mixed with confusion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ten minutes were nearing their..."
entries.dialogueText: The ten minutes were nearing their end. With a glance at me, Titus gracefully feinted to the right just in time for his opponent to land a forceful blow to his jaw.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chanting ceased and the circle..."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The Lord has blessed us with a bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord has blessed us with a beautiful fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal signaled for the circle to st..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal signaled for the circle to stop chanting. He stepped in and gleefully applauded.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The Lord has blessed us with a bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord has blessed us with a beautiful fight. This bodes well for our two countries."

entries.dialogueText: The Garrison's grounds were much larger than I would have guessed -- almost the size of Porte Drazon's Old Town.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: A gleaming silver pillar rose up from the center, surrounded by a cluster of administrative and religious buildings. Greenhouses, storage silos and living quarters lined the perimeter, separated from the inner circle by a clear natural stream.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The first residents we saw were wom..."
entries.dialogueText: The first residents we saw were women in identical white dresses, drawing water from the stream and carrying baskets of vegetables to and from the greenhouses.

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The Disciples. They practice purif..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Disciples. They practice purification of the spirit through strict martial arts regimens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I bet Titus could take them all on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Derdia's famed mercenaries are indeed Disciples. If undertaken in the service of a cause they align with, their work counts as progress towards their spiritual ascendance."

entries.dialogueText: On it, some four dozen men were engaged in combat drills. Titus watched in open admiration as they executed a complex choreography of strikes, blocks and counterattacks, each punctuated by a forceful cry.

entries.title: Narrator: "Loran moved with a fluid unpredicta..."
entries.dialogueText: Loran moved with a fluid unpredictability. His blows seemed to come out of nowhere, but landed with tactical precision.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Yet somehow, miraculously, I was holding my own against the Derdian fighter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I threw a right hook. He winced as..."
entries.dialogueText: I threw a right hook. He winced as it landed on his shoulder, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I threw a jab with my left hand. It..."
entries.dialogueText: I threw a jab with my left hand. It hit his shoulder, and he staggered backwards slightly with a smile.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I attempted a roundhouse kick with..."
entries.dialogueText: I attempted a roundhouse kick with my good leg. He twisted just in time for my foot to hit his shoulder. He winced, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, come on! Is that all you've go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, come on! Is that all you've got?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That one was for Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "That one was for Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued sparring, Loran mostly..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued sparring, Loran mostly dodging my blows with ease but occasionally allowing one or two to land.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued sparring. Loran's blow..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued sparring. Loran's blows began landing a little harder, but I was still able to get a hit or two in.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop holding back! Show me how a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop holding back! Show me how a real Disciple fights!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're not actually that tough, ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not actually that tough, are you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing and concentrated on..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing and concentrated on our duel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loran smiled uncomfortably. He step..."
entries.dialogueText: Loran smiled uncomfortably. He stepped back and performed a flashy spin kick that missed my face by just a few centimeters.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""FUCK YOUR GOD AND HIT ME! THE KING..."
entries.dialogueText: "FUCK YOUR GOD AND HIT ME! THE KING COMMANDS IT!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shock mixed with rage on the Derdia..."
entries.dialogueText: Shock mixed with rage on the Derdian's face. His fist felt like a brick as it connected with the side of my face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loran didn't respond. He kept fight..."
entries.dialogueText: Loran didn't respond. He kept fighting much the same as before.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "While his back was still turned, I..."
entries.dialogueText: While his back was still turned, I threw my most forceful punch yet.
entries.menuText: Hit him while he's off guard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took it on the ribcage with grac..."
entries.dialogueText: He took it on the ribcage with grace and allowed himself to collapse to the ground, holding up both hands in a sign of concession.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A searing jolt of pain radiated thr..."
entries.dialogueText: A searing jolt of pain radiated through my skull. I collapsed to the ground.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I concede!""
entries.dialogueText: "I concede!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop the duel!""
entries.dialogueText: "Stop the duel!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I allowed his punch to land on my r..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed his punch to land on my ribcage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I allowed myself to fall to the gro..."
entries.dialogueText: I allowed myself to fall to the ground, holding my hands up in a sign of concession.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal signaled for the circle to st..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal signaled for the circle to stop chanting. He gleefully applauded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I think I needed that."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal

entries.dialogueText: "I admit I was shocked at your disrespect, Your Majesty. But a true Golcondist does not give in to his emotions so easily."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Redemption may often be found thro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Redemption may often be found through pain, Your Majesty. Though I admit I was shocked at your show of disrespect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Your man is a brute. He does not deserve to become an Adept."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal

entries.dialogueText: "Your behavior was most disrespectful, Your Majesty. But he should have had the moral strength to resist."
